stories.title: Define sponsor credibility schema and score contract
stories.description: Create data schema and scoring contract for sponsor credibility including sponsor_type (NIH, Industry, Academic, Other), normalized credibility_score (0-1), and explanation fields. Ensure compatibility with existing clinical_trials_service outputs and facade response models.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/clinical_trials_service.py — sponsor metadata (lead_sponsor, collaborator, agency_class) available for mapping; Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_models/clinical_trials_models.py — existing Pydantic models to extend

stories.title: Implement sponsor credibility scoring logic
stories.description: Build scoring function that maps ClinicalTrials.gov sponsor agency_class values (NIH, Industry, Other, Academic if inferred) to weighted credibility scores. Include deterministic mapping, fallback handling for missing/unknown sponsors, and collaborator influence rules.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/clinical_trials_service.py — provides sponsor metadata fields (lead_sponsor.agency_class, collaborators) required for scoring

stories.title: Expose sponsor credibility in evaluation API
stories.description: Integrate sponsor credibility score into Evaluate Care facade response for clinical trials. Ensure the score and explanation are included in the response payload returned to the chat layer.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/facades/evaluate_care_facade.py — orchestrates clinical trial evaluation responses and is integration point for new measure

stories.title: Unit and integration tests for sponsor credibility scoring
stories.description: Write unit tests for scoring logic across sponsor types and edge cases (missing sponsor, multiple collaborators). Add integration test validating presence of sponsor credibility in API response.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/ — existing test suite patterns for service and facade testing; clinical_trials_service integration tested indirectly
